title: Fast RMX
subtitle: A launch-day race above the ground
summary: Fast RMX is Shin'en Multimedia's futuristic racing game, released alongside Nintendo Switch on 3 March 2017.
body: Fast RMX is Shin'en Multimedia's futuristic racing game, released alongside Nintendo Switch on 3 March 2017. Anti-gravity vehicles race through industrial structures, deserts and other high-speed circuits. It expands Fast Racing Neo with new courses while adapting the series to the Switch's portable and docked forms. The defining action is changing the vehicle's phase between two colours, matching boost strips and jump pads as the track rushes towards the player and an approaching corner competes for attention.

A matching phase lets the vehicle benefit from a coloured section of track. Reading that colour, switching in time and maintaining a useful racing line become parts of the same movement. Energy collected around the course supplies additional boosts, giving the player some control over where to accelerate beyond the fixed strips. Grand Prix events group races into cups, rewarding consistent placement rather than a single successful lap. Faster classes make previously manageable routes demand earlier decisions and more precise reactions.

The original release offered thirty courses, with a later free update increasing the total to thirty-six. Local split-screen supports four players, and online races allow up to eight. Hero Mode changes the risk by making boost energy serve as the machine's health as well, so spending everything for speed can leave little margin for a collision. Fast RMX concentrates its identity in that continuing balance between reading the next coloured section and deciding how much acceleration the current situation can safely afford.
